title: Meshy and Tripo data-retention and training terms, with a vendor recommendation for M2
summary: Same as M0-LEGAL-03 for the two candidate head-generation vendors, plus a comparison that lets the Foreman file the account AUTH for the right one.

acceptance_tests.test: legal/vendors/meshy.md and legal/vendors/tripo.md record retention, deletion path, training-by-default and opt-out, DPA availability, region, with quotes, links, retrieval date.

A comparison table (realistic-mode quality claims, price per generation, API limits, deletion guarantees, biometric-specific terms) ends with a recommendation and the draft AUTH REQUEST text for the Foreman's batch.
Any vendor that trains on customer images by default without an opt-out is marked 'do not use for user data'.
